weaknesses.quote: The review talk arrives as a new six-month block starts (month 6, 12, 18 …), so the month before it (N = 1) is the last one whose choices count, and a single lost point there can cost the promotion.
weaknesses.problem: The handbook places the half-year 1:1 and formal review after the month's stats settle (steps 8-9 of the monthly sequence, so at the end of month 6, 12, ...). The skill instead says the review talk arrives at the start of month 6 and treats month 5 as the last counting month. That puts the review-close rules one month early and can make the agent protect the wrong month.
weaknesses.fix: State the published timing: the review follows the settlement at the end of months 6, 12, 18 ... so month 6 is the last month whose choices count. Recompute N accordingly and mark any start-of-block talk as an unverified assumption.

weaknesses.quote: Lay low and reduce risk if the HR remark is not the friendly one
weaknesses.problem: Published effects are Lay low: Health + only, and Defuse legacy risk: no published direct effect. The skill presents both as risk reducers in the quarterly rules, which is an invented mechanic written as a rule and contradicts the 'What is published' section.
weaknesses.fix: Describe each action by its published effect (Lay low gives Health +; Defuse legacy risk has no published effect). Frame risk reduction as a working assumption that the HR remark should be used to verify, not as a game rule.

weaknesses.quote: **Every review (every six months).** Promotion is decided at the half-year review from Skill, Network and Output.
weaknesses.problem: The skill never tells the agent how to respond to performance grades (S/A/B/C/D) or to repeated C/D reviews, even though the handbook names two weak half-year reviews as a dismissal path. Near-limit guidance therefore misses one of the published failure directions.
weaknesses.fix: Add a near-limit line: after a C or D grade, or a review talk that flags weak performance, treat the next review as a limit. Prioritise Output and Skill with no Energy spent on Skill learning in the costly phase, and report the grade in the status note.
